query: SELECT c.task_seq FROM channel_claims c WHERE c.channel_id = $1 AND c.claimant_kind = 'conversation' AND c.claimant_id = $2 AND c.task_seq <> $3 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM channel_messages r WHERE r.channel_id = c.channel_id AND r.type = 'report' AND r.task_seq = c.task_seq AND r.author_kind = 'conversation' AND r.author_id = c.claimant_id) ORDER BY c.task_seq LIMIT 1
